Lorin is one of  Auntie Ethel's victims. He is in the Entrance Gallery of the Overgrown Tunnel shouting at the party to stay back, and not to look. Lorin came to Auntie Ethel to look into his future and see what life path to pick.
“
My gentle Lorin. He wished to know what was to come.
„
— Auntie Ethel, on Lorin's fate

Overview

Act One

If the party speak with Lorin while  Auntie Ethel still lives, he tries to avoid looking at them, but eventually turns if they continue to speak to him. Lorin exclaims in panic that the interacting party member is a monster, seeing them as a Mind Flayer.

If he is spoken with again after killing Auntie Ethel, Lorin remembers seeing the party member as a Mind Flayer and runs away. If a party member does not speak to him before killing Auntie Ethel, he is more reasonable, yet still scared.
